input.answer: Regular unleaded gasoline at self-serve stations in Calgary rose 26.6% from September 2025 to September 2026. The price went from 132.2 to 167.3 cents per litre. Arithmetic: (167.3 − 132.2) / 132.2 = 35.1 / 132.2 = 26.55%, rounded to 26.6%. The change is +35.1 cents per litre. The table gives prices in cents per litre, though it doesn't label the unit.
